candidates.statement: Order service postgres save_order spans fail with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool shows size 5 and idle 0 across all sampled traces, so checkout requests time out at the gateway (502) after ~2s. Pool exhaustion at the order->postgresql dependency is the bounded root cause.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side metrics or logs; pool idle=0 could reflect either exhaustion or upstream DB unavailability.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout correlation failing at postgres.save_order with DependencyUnavailable and pool idle=0, propagating 503 from order and 502 at gateway; gateway metrics show /v1/checkout 502s with p95 ~2406ms. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion. Logs were excluded, so postgres-side confirmation is still required.
